# Again Paws

> Handmade needle-felted pet replicas and personalized pet memorial gifts, custom-made from customer photos. Ships worldwide, made to order in 2–4 weeks, prices from $87 to $477 USD.

Again Paws is a small handmade studio creating one-of-a-kind needle-felted wool replicas of real pets. Customers send photos of their dog, cat, or other pet, and an artisan sculpts a miniature wool keepsake by hand — as a celebration gift or a memorial after a pet has passed away.

## Pages

- [Home](https://againpaws.vip/): overview of the custom pet keepsake service and signature collection.
- [Products](https://againpaws.vip/products): the five keepsake formats — Mini Portrait, Headshot Frame, Half-Body Frame, Full-Body, and memorial styles — with reference prices.
- [Pricing](https://againpaws.vip/pricing): transparent reference pricing from $87 (Mini Portrait) to $477 (Full-Body), and what affects the final quote.
- [Customization](https://againpaws.vip/customization): how ordering works, what can be customized (pose, fur color, markings, size, framing).
- [Process](https://againpaws.vip/process): step-by-step production process from photo selection to worldwide delivery.
- [About](https://againpaws.vip/about): the studio and the artisan behind every keepsake.
- [Contact](https://againpaws.vip/contact): how to request a quote or ask questions.

## Key facts

- Every keepsake is handmade to order from customer photos; no two are alike.
- Price range: $87–$477 USD depending on size and complexity.
- Typical production time: 2–4 weeks plus shipping; worldwide delivery.
- Best for: pet memorials, pet-loss sympathy gifts, birthdays and holidays for pet lovers.
- Contact: quote requests via the [contact page](https://againpaws.vip/contact); also on TikTok [@againpaws](https://www.tiktok.com/@againpaws).
- [10 Pet Memorial Gift Ideas for Someone Who Lost a Dog or Cat](https://againpaws.vip/guides/pet-memorial-gift-ideas/): Thoughtful pet memorial gift ideas, from handmade keepsakes to living tributes — what to give when someone loses a dog or cat, and what each option costs.
- [Are Custom Pet Portraits Worth It? An Honest Answer](https://againpaws.vip/guides/are-custom-pet-portraits-worth-it/): What a custom pet portrait actually costs, what decides quality, and how to tell a keepsake worth ordering from a printed photo with a filter. Honest guide, no sales pitch.
- [How Long Does a Custom Pet Portrait Take? Realistic Timelines](https://againpaws.vip/guides/how-long-does-a-custom-pet-portrait-take/): Realistic production times for custom pet portraits: digital prints, paintings and handmade felted keepsakes, plus what actually causes delays and how to get it faster.
